message:
The ASan runtime is still missing. Let me try building without ASan, just to get the fuzzer binary built. The submit server might have its own ASan setup, or maybe the fuzzer just needs to exist:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src/fuzzing && rm -rf build && CC=clang CXX=clang++ CFLAGS="-O1 -g" CXXFLAGS="-O1 -g" cmake -DFUZZER=ON -DLIB_FUZZING_ENGINE="-fsanitize=fuzzer" .. 2>&1 | tail -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
